instruction: Please disable the 'Allow only one instance' setting in VLC so that multiple VLC windows can be opened from file manager.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's single instance mode when started from file manager. Evaluator uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric to verify VLC config has one-instance-when-started-from-file=0.
